name: finalize-manifest-39
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
L=pathlib.Path.cwd();exclude={'manifest.json','finalize-manifest-39.receipt.json','finalize-manifest-39.output.txt'};files=[]
for p in sorted(L.rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file():continue
 rel=str(p.relative_to(L))
 if rel in exclude:continue
 b=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
assert any(x['path']=='frozen-after.json' for x in files)
obj={'files':files,'terminal_non_circular_exclusions':{'manifest.json':'Self hash cannot be embedded in itself.','finalize-manifest-39.receipt.json':'Runner writes this receipt only after this manifest child completes; not completed at manifest construction.','finalize-manifest-39.output.txt':'Runner writes terminal stdout only after this manifest child completes; not completed at manifest construction.'},'completed_receipt_jsons':sum(x['path'].endswith('.receipt.json') or x['path']=='bootstrap-receipt.json' for x in files),'frozen_after':'13 bindings checked, zero mismatches; no subsequent frozen write','scope':'Every existing own-lane file including mutable budgets, locks, full source/search outputs, plans, all completed receipts and handoff documents, except exact terminal exclusions'}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'manifest.json'],input=json.dumps(obj,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(files),'completed_receipts':obj['completed_receipt_jsons'],'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256((L/'manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'all_frozen_after':13,'qualified_survivors':0}))
